regime_context: The detector shows eligible leadership concentrated in materials (Base Metals, Silver & Royalties, Gold Miners) with broad breadth and moderate durability. No single narrative dominates; the absolute-trend gate filters out deeply negative themes like Telecom. Technology and defensives lag, while macro news is heavy on AI and geopolitics and highly unscheduled, providing coincident market-level noise.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate (validated risk control) supports staying with the leading theme, which shows full breadth (1.0) and above-average durability (0.71). Remaining in an eligible, uncrowded leader aligns with the gate's drawdown-avoidance benefit, even though momentum has no return-forecasting edge.
theses.dissent: Base metals are highly cyclical; a global growth shock or China demand collapse could reverse the trend abruptly, overriding any risk-control benefit.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its 200-day simple moving average on a weekly basis.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology ranks 14/16 with a negative score, yet remains eligible, suggesting the trend is not yet broken but momentum is poor. Crowded positioning (crowded true) and the lack of positive breadth increase the risk of continued underperformance. Underweighting reduces exposure to a lagging sector that may face unwind pressure.
theses.dissent: A resurgence in AI capital-excitement could trigger a sharp mean-reversion rally in tech; underweight would miss that move.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Telecom
theses.thesis: Telecom has failed the absolute-trend gate (ineligible), has a deeply negative score (-0.983), zero breadth, and near-zero durability (0.13). This signals a broken trend and high likelihood of continued underperformance. Avoiding it directly follows the validated drawdown-avoidance logic.
theses.dissent: A sudden regulatory tailwind or consolidation wave could cause a sharp reversal, which the trend gate would not capture in time.

falsifier.text: XCD.TO gains more than 10% from its 2026-08-10 close before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
